steps: Universe: TQQQ long (3× QQQ), cash. BIL only as a pre-registered variant.

Clock: one decision per session at 15:58 ET. Entry at the open of the session's last 1-minute bar (~15:59), exit at the open of the next session's 32nd bar (~10:01). Holding period ≈ 17 hours. Half days use the same bar offsets, so the entry is the half-day close.
Signal 1 (closing pressure): c30 = QQQ log return from the 15:29 close to the 15:58 close, i.e. the last 30 minutes before the entry. z = c30 / median(|c30|, previous 20 sessions).
Signal 2 (risk state): v = annualised stdev of the previous 10 completed block log returns; m = median of v over the previous 60 sessions.

Gate: on iff sign(c30) == close_sign (default −1), |c30| >= 0.5 · median(|c30|, previous 20 sessions) (the closing move must be at least half a typical one, so noise does not trigger a trade), and v <= 1.5 m, and both statistics exist.

Size: min(1, 0.40 / v) when the gate is on, else 0. 0.40 is roughly the block's own median annualised vol, so a normal-vol night gets size ≈ 1 and a 2× vol night gets ≈ 0.5. The magnitude of c30 is used only as the entry threshold, not as a continuous size, to keep the number of fitted continuous parameters small.
brief.why: The overnight+first-30m block pays because it settles the previous session's closing pressure, so it should be held selectively after a sold close rather than every night.
falsifiers: F1 sign and size. Mean block log return after c30 < 0 must exceed the mean after c30 >= 0 by at least 5 bp/night, two-sample t ≥ 1.5. F2 conditioning must pay. V1 (conditioning only, size fixed at 1) must beat V0 (unconditional, size fixed at 1) on dev CAGR at 1 bp. Comparing V1 with V0 keeps size out of it, so the test isolates the conditioning. If V1 does not beat V0, the closing condition adds nothing and the remainder is the old residue → retired_overlay_only.
F3 risk. Dev max DD ≤ 45%, Sharpe ≥ 0.70 at 1 bp.
F4 stability. The conditional sign must hold in at least 2 of the 3 dev sub-periods (2016–19, 2020–21, 2022–23).
F5 placebo. 200 random night selections with the same number of active nights must produce a mean dev CAGR below the real strategy, p < 0.10.

# `time-of-day` — rebuild (closing-pressure overnight carry)

**Status: SPEC FROZEN, NOT YET TESTED.** Backtests are paused by the lead. No
number in this report has been produced. Every result cell below is `PENDING`
and will be filled by a single authorised run of `strategy.py`, which writes
`result.json`.

---

## 1. The idea, and why it is not the old overlay

The original strategy held **TQQQ every night** (15:59 → 10:01) and used a
165-day QQQ trend gate to decide whether to hold at all. Its report itself says
the gate does most of the risk work and that the unconditional overnight block
is the return engine.

Removing that gate leaves "buy TQQQ every night", which is exactly the residue
the 2026-11-26 clarification prohibits. So this rebuild keeps the *clock* — the
one thing that is genuinely this strategy's own — and replaces the *reason to
hold* with a mechanism that comes from the closing auction rather than from a
slow trend:

> The last 30 minutes of the session are the only reliably negative block of the
> day. That selling is price pressure, not information, and it is reversed when
> liquidity returns the next morning. Therefore the overnight block should pay
> **more after a sold close than after a bought close**, and the strategy should
> hold only the nights that follow genuine closing pressure.

The old strategy could not express this: it was unconditional (modulo the trend
gate) and binary. This one is conditional, continuous in size, and its gate is a
statistic of the strategy's *own* block returns rather than of the index level.

## 2. Hypothesis

- **H1.** The overnight+first-30m block return is a decreasing function of the
  QQQ return over the last 30 minutes of the preceding session. Holding only
  after negative closing blocks beats holding every night.
- **H2.** The conditional edge dies in high-volatility states, so the sleeve must
  also require the block's own realised volatility to be within 1.5× its
  60-session median.
- **H0.** Closing-block information is worthless and the conditional strategy is
  a random subset of nights.

The direction is genuinely contested in the literature: the cross-sectional
open literature (Berkman et al. 2012) says the open is temporarily inflated and
then reverses, which supports H1; the market-level intraday-momentum literature
(Gao et al. 2018) says the close continues the morning, which would support the
opposite sign. Variant **V4** runs the opposite sign explicitly, so the sign is
measured, not assumed.

## 3. Specification (frozen)

| element | value |
|---|---|
| Universe | TQQQ long (3× QQQ); cash. BIL only in variant V5. |
| Timeframe | 1-minute bars, regular session only |
| Decision | once per session, at 15:58 ET, using data through bar `last-1` |
| Entry | open of the session's **last** 1-minute bar (~15:59; 12:59 on half days) |
| Exit | open of the next session's **32nd** bar (~10:01) |
| Holding period | ≈ 17 hours per active night |
| Closing signal | `c30` = QQQ log return, 15:29 close → 15:58 close (bar offsets, so half days work) |
| Signal normaliser | `|c30| >= 0.5 × median(|c30|, previous 20 sessions)` |
| Risk state | `v` = annualised stdev of the previous 10 *completed* block log returns |
| Risk reference | `m` = median of `v` over the previous 60 sessions |
| Gate | `sign(c30) == -1` **and** `|c30| >= 0.5·median` **and** `v <= 1.5 m` |
| Size | `min(1, 0.40 / v)` when the gate is on, else 0 |
| Leverage | none beyond TQQQ's own 3× daily reset; weights ∈ {0} ∪ (0, 1] |
| Shorts | none |
| Costs tested | 1 bp (headline), 5 bp, 10 bp |

**Causality.** A block entered on session *k* ends at ~10:01 of session *k+1*, so
at 15:58 of session *k* the newest completed block is *k−1*. The `c30` of
session *k* uses closes up to bar `last−1`, and the entry fills at the open of
bar `last`, so the signal never sees the fill price. The magnitude reference uses
only the previous 20 sessions.

**No shared base.** No 100–250-day moving average of QQQ, TQQQ, SPY or NDX
appears in the strategy path. `baseline_weights()` in `strategy.py` is a
separable function used *only* to measure the correlation requirement; it is
never called by `build_weights()` and never touches the weights.

## 4. Pre-registered variants (6)

| id | rule | role |
|---|---|---|
| V0 | unconditional: every night, size 1 | reference / the old residue |
| V1 | `c30 < 0` only, size 1 | isolates the conditioning (F2) |
| V2 | vol gate only, size 1 | isolates the risk state |
| **V3** | **full: closing gate + vol gate + `0.40/v` sizing** | **the strategy** |
| V4 | full but `c30 > 0` | the momentum branch, settles the sign |
| V5 | full but BIL instead of cash while flat | does bill carry pay for the round trips? |

Neighbourhood (±1 step around V3, reported in full including losing cells):
`vol_look` 5/10/20 · `ref_look` 40/60/90 · `vol_mult` 1.25/1.50/2.00 ·
`close_window` 20/30/45 · `close_min_z` 0.0/0.5/1.0 · `vol_target` 0.30/0.40/0.50.

Parameters are accepted only if V3 sits on a **plateau**, not a peak.

## 5. Falsifiers and decision rule

| id | test | fail action |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | mean block return after sold close exceeds after bought close by ≥5 bp/night, t ≥ 1.5 | if reversed, run V4 once; if V4 also fails → retire |
| F2 | V1 (conditioning) beats V0 (unconditional) on dev CAGR at 1 bp, both size 1 | retire as overlay-only |
| F3 | dev max DD ≤ 45% and Sharpe ≥ 0.70 at 1 bp | reject |
| F4 | conditional sign holds in ≥2 of 3 dev sub-periods | reject |
| F5 | 200-shuffle placebo: real dev CAGR above the placebo distribution, p < 0.10 | reject |
| F6 | dev daily-return correlation with the 165-day base < 0.60 | reject |
| F7 | at 5 bp still beats TQQQ buy-and-hold on dev | mark `fragile`, not `passed` |

If F2 fails the honest outcome is `retired_overlay_only`: the clock alone is the
old residue and the closing condition adds nothing.

`strategy.py::decide()` maps F1–F7 to the `status` field mechanically
(`passed` / `fragile` / `retired_overlay_only` / `rejected`); the status is never
typed into `result.json` by hand.

## 7. Known weaknesses, stated in advance

1. **The sign of the closing→overnight link is the least certain part.** If it
   runs the other way the strategy is V4, and if neither works the idea is dead.
2. **Duty cycle.** Expect roughly 40–50 % of nights active. That is deliberate:
   it is the main reason the strategy can decorrelate from the old base, and it
   also means the strategy will lag badly in a bull market where the overnight
   drift is unconditional.
3. **Cost.** Two fills per active night. At a 45 % duty cycle that is ~0.9 round
   trips/day, so the 1 bp result is the only one likely to clear TQQQ; 5 bp and
   10 bp are reported as the honest stress.
4. **Half days.** Entry uses the last bar and the exit uses bar 32 of the next
   session, so a half-day entry happens at 12:59 — the position then misses the
   half-day's final move and holds a longer overnight. This is a real, if small,
   modelling choice and is flagged rather than smoothed over.
5. **BIL.** If V5 loses to cash, the reason is the extra round trip; that is a
   finding, not a bug.

# Hypothesis and pre-registration — `time-of-day` (revisit)

Written before any code was run. Nothing in this file has been fitted to data.
Backtests are paused; the numbers in `report.md` do not exist yet.

## 1. What the original strategy actually contained

The original (`research/agents/time-of-day/`) held TQQQ from the 15:59 open to
the 10:01 open next morning and was in cash otherwise, gated by QQQ versus its
165-day SMA with a 2% hysteresis band. Its own report attributes the return to
two facts: **78% of TQQQ's log return accrues outside the cash session**, and
**the last 30 minutes of the session are the only reliably negative block of the
day** (−5.74% CAGR, −1.48 bp/day over 2,700 sessions).

Strip the 165-day gate and what remains is "be long TQQQ every night". That is
the residue the clarification warns about, and it is the *reference variant*
V0 here, not the strategy.

## 2. The one genuinely new idea

The old strategy treats every night as identical except for a slow trend gate.
But the reason the overnight block pays is that **it is the settlement window for
the session's imbalances**: the closing 30 minutes are systematically sold, and
that selling pressure is reversed once liquidity returns the next morning
(Berkman et al. 2012 on the open; Heston et al. 2010 on half-hour periodicity;
Lou et al. 2019 on the overnight/intraday clientele split).

If that is the mechanism, the overnight return should be *conditional on the
closing block*: nights that follow a **sold close** should pay more than nights
that follow a **bought close**. The old strategy could not express this — it was
unconditional (modulo the trend gate) and binary.

**Hypothesis H1.** The overnight+first-30m block return is a decreasing function
of the QQQ return over the last 30 minutes of the preceding session. A strategy
that holds only after negative closing blocks, and sizes with the magnitude of
the closing move, earns a higher return per night and a higher Sharpe than the
unconditional version.

**Hypothesis H2 (risk).** The conditional edge is destroyed in high-volatility
states, so the sleeve must also require the block's *own* realised volatility to
be within 1.5× its 60-session median.

**Hypothesis H0 (null).** Closing-block information is worthless; the conditional
strategy is a random subset of nights and cannot beat V0 after costs.

## 3. Why this is not the old overlay

| dimension | original | this rebuild |
|---|---|---|
| position rule | every night, gated by QQQ/165d SMA | only nights after a sold close, gated by the block's own realised vol |
| gate input | 165-day price trend on QQQ | last-30-minute return + 10-session realised vol of the strategy's own block |
| sizing | binary 0/1, driven by the gate | continuous 0–1, driven by closing-pressure magnitude and vol |
| holding | 15:59 → 10:01 every night | 15:59 → 10:01 on a conditioned ~45% of nights |
| return driver | equity beta overnight | the closing-to-open reversal, i.e. *when* the overnight is held |
| assets | TQQQ / BIL | TQQQ / cash (BIL tested as V5) |

No 100–250-day moving average on QQQ, TQQQ, SPY or NDX appears anywhere. No
weights, functions or files from the original implementation are reused.

## 4. Universe, signal, holding period, sizing, risk

- **Universe:** TQQQ long (3× QQQ), cash. BIL only as a pre-registered variant.
- **Clock:** one decision per session at 15:58 ET. Entry at the open of the
  session's last 1-minute bar (~15:59), exit at the open of the next session's
  32nd bar (~10:01). Holding period ≈ 17 hours. Half days use the same
  bar offsets, so the entry is the half-day close.
- **Signal 1 (closing pressure):** `c30` = QQQ log return from the 15:29 close to
  the 15:58 close, i.e. the last 30 minutes *before* the entry. `z = c30 /
  median(|c30|, previous 20 sessions)`.
- **Signal 2 (risk state):** `v` = annualised stdev of the previous 10 completed
  block log returns; `m` = median of `v` over the previous 60 sessions.
- **Gate:** on iff `sign(c30) == close_sign` (default −1), `|c30| >= 0.5 ·
  median(|c30|, previous 20 sessions)` (the closing move must be at least half a
  typical one, so noise does not trigger a trade), and `v <= 1.5 m`, and both
  statistics exist.
- **Size:** `min(1, 0.40 / v)` when the gate is on, else 0. 0.40 is roughly the
  block's own median annualised vol, so a normal-vol night gets size ≈ 1 and a
  2× vol night gets ≈ 0.5. The magnitude of `c30` is used only as the entry
  threshold, not as a continuous size, to keep the number of fitted continuous
  parameters small.
- **Risk:** no leverage beyond size 1, no shorts, one block at a time, hard flat
  when `v > 1.5 m`.

## 5. Falsifiers (all evaluated on development only, 2016-01-04 → 2023-12-29)

1. **F1 sign and size.** Mean block log return after `c30 < 0` must exceed the
   mean after `c30 >= 0` by at least 5 bp/night, two-sample t ≥ 1.5. If the sign
   is reversed, the "sold close reverses overnight" mechanism is wrong. One
   re-specification to the opposite sign is allowed (`c30 > 0`, variant V4);
   if that also fails, retire.
2. **F2 conditioning must pay.** V1 (conditioning only, size fixed at 1) must
   beat V0 (unconditional, size fixed at 1) on dev CAGR at 1 bp. Comparing V1
   with V0 keeps size out of it, so the test isolates the conditioning. If V1
   does not beat V0, the closing condition adds nothing and the remainder is the
   old residue → `retired_overlay_only`.
3. **F3 risk.** Dev max DD ≤ 45%, Sharpe ≥ 0.70 at 1 bp.
4. **F4 stability.** The conditional sign must hold in at least 2 of the 3 dev
   sub-periods (2016–19, 2020–21, 2022–23).
5. **F5 placebo.** 200 random night selections with the same number of active
   nights must produce a mean dev CAGR below the real strategy, p < 0.10.
6. **F6 independence.** Daily-return correlation with the rebuilt 165-day
   baseline < 0.60 on dev. Expected 0.35–0.55. If ≥ 0.60 the design fails the
   brief even if profitable.
7. **F7 cost.** At 5 bp the strategy must still beat TQQQ buy-and-hold on dev,
   else it is marked `fragile` rather than `passed`.

## 6. Pre-registered variants (6) and parameter neighbourhood

| id | rule |
|---|---|
| V0 | unconditional always-on (reference / residue) |
| V1 | `c30 < 0` only, size 1, no vol gate |
| V2 | vol gate only, no closing condition |
| **V3** | **full: `c30 < 0` + vol gate + continuous size (the strategy)** |
| V4 | full, opposite sign (`c30 > 0`) — the momentum branch |
| V5 | full, but BIL instead of cash while flat |

Neighbourhood (±1 step, chosen from a plateau, not the peak): `vol_look`
5/10/20; `ref_look` 40/60/90; `vol_mult` 1.25/1.50/2.00; `close_window`
20/30/45 minutes; `vol_target` 0.30/0.40/0.50.

The neighbourhood is reported in full, including losing cells. Parameters are
only accepted if V3 sits on a plateau, not a spike.

## 7. Freeze protocol

1. All development work, including the neighbourhood and the placebo, uses only
   2016-01-04 → 2023-12-29. The panel loader is called with `panel_end=DEV_END`.
2. Parameters are frozen to the values in §4 before the holdout is touched.
3. Only then is the panel re-loaded through 2026-10-23 and the frozen weights run
   once to fill `windows.10y` and `windows.5y` (these overlap the holdout and are
   labelled as such).
4. `windows.holdout` is left for the lead.

## 8. Provenance

See `report.md` §"Provenance" for the full source table with URLs. Primary
sources for this hypothesis:

- Berkman, Koch, Tuttle & Zhang (2012), *Paying Attention: Overnight Returns and
  the Hidden Cost of Buying at the Open*, JFQA 47(4) — positive overnight returns
  followed by intraday reversal, driven by a temporary inflation of the opening
  price. https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1625495
- Heston, Korajczyk & Sadka (2010), *Intraday Patterns in the Cross-Section of
  Stock Returns*, JF 65(4) — return continuation at half-hour intervals that are
  exact multiples of a trading day. https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.3535
- Lou, Polk & Skouras (2019), *A Tug of War: Overnight versus Intraday Expected
  Returns*, JFE — separate clienteles at the open and the close.
  https://ifr.hkust.edu.hk/uploads/upload/files/20250212/445bce5ab83ffca69c4fe4b56c8055e1.pdf
- Cliff, Cooper & Gulen (2008), *Return Differences between Trading and
  Non-Trading Hours* — the unconditional overnight premium that V0 tests.
  https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1004081
- Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018), *Market Intraday Momentum*, JFE 129(2) — the first
  half-hour predicts the last half-hour; the reason the exit is at 10:01 rather
  than 09:31. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfineco.2018.05.009

The closing-pressure *direction* is the part I am least sure about: the
cross-sectional literature (Berkman et al.) says the open is temporarily
inflated then reverses, while the market-level intraday-momentum literature
(Gao et al.) says the close continues the first half-hour. F1 and V4 are
designed to settle exactly this, and the sign is not assumed in the code —
`close_sign` is an explicit parameter.

## 3. Specification (frozen)

| element | value |
|---|---|
| Universe | TQQQ long (3× QQQ); cash. BIL only in variant V5. |
| Timeframe | 1-minute bars, regular session only |
| Decision | once per session, at 15:58 ET, using data through bar `last-1` |
| Entry | open of the session's **last** 1-minute bar (~15:59; 12:59 on half days) |
| Exit | open of the next session's **32nd** bar (~10:01) |
| Holding period | ≈ 17 hours per active night |
| Closing signal | `c30` = QQQ log return, 15:29 close → 15:58 close (bar offsets, so half days work) |
| Signal normaliser | `|c30| >= 0.5 × median(|c30|, previous 20 sessions)` |
| Risk state | `v` = annualised stdev of the previous 10 *completed* block log returns |
| Risk reference | `m` = median of `v` over the previous 60 sessions |
| Gate | `sign(c30) == -1` **and** `|c30| >= 0.5·median` **and** `v <= 1.5 m` |
| Size | `min(1, 0.40 / v)` when the gate is on, else 0 |
| Leverage | none beyond TQQQ's own 3× daily reset; weights ∈ {0} ∪ (0, 1] |
| Shorts | none |
| Costs tested | 1 bp (headline), 5 bp, 10 bp |

**Causality.** A block entered on session *k* ends at ~10:01 of session *k+1*, so
at 15:58 of session *k* the newest completed block is *k−1*. The `c30` of
session *k* uses closes up to bar `last−1`, and the entry fills at the open of
bar `last`, so the signal never sees the fill price. The magnitude reference uses
only the previous 20 sessions.

**No shared base.** No 100–250-day moving average of QQQ, TQQQ, SPY or NDX
appears in the strategy path. `baseline_weights()` in `strategy.py` is a
separable function used *only* to measure the correlation requirement; it is
never called by `build_weights()` and never touches the weights.

"""Revisit: `time-of-day` rebuilt as a conditional closing-pressure carry.

NOT YET RUN.  This file is the frozen specification; `python strategy.py` is
deliberately not executed until the lead authorises the test.

The strategy
------------
Universe: TQQQ (long, 3x QQQ) and cash.
Clock   : one decision per session at 15:58 ET.
           - entry at the open of the session's LAST 1-minute bar (~15:59)
           - exit  at the open of the next session's 32nd bar (~10:01)
           - flat otherwise -> holding period about 17 hours
Signal  : (1) closing pressure = QQQ log return over the last ``close_window``
              minutes of the session, measured *before* the entry;
          (2) risk state = the block's own realised volatility.
Gate    : hold only when the closing block moved against the sign we want
          (``close_sign``, default -1 = "the close was sold"), the move is at
          least ``close_min_z`` typical closing moves, and the block's realised
          vol is within ``vol_mult`` of its 60-session median.
Size    : ``min(1, vol_target / realised_vol)`` while the gate is on, else 0.

No 100-250 day moving average of QQQ/TQQQ/SPY/NDX is used anywhere.  The only
regime inputs are the closing 30 minutes and the strategy's own completed block
returns.  All of them are strictly causal:

  * a block entered on session k ends at ~10:01 of session k+1, so at 15:58 of
    session k the newest completed block is k-1;
  * ``c30`` on session k uses closes up to bar (last-1) of session k, and the
    entry fills at the open of the last bar, so it cannot see the fill price;
  * the magnitude reference is the median of |c30| over the previous 20
    sessions only.

Development window 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29.  The holdout is never loaded while
parameters are chosen: ``load(DEV_END)`` is the only panel call used for
development.  ``windows.10y`` and ``windows.5y`` in result.json are filled once,
after the freeze, from a separate panel that overlaps the holdout.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BARS_1M = 252 * 390

DEV_START = "2016-01-04"
DEV_END = "2023-12-29"
FULL_END = "2026-10-23"
T10, T5 = "2017-01-03", "2021-10-25"
DEV_ONLY = os.environ.get("REVISIT_DEV_ONLY") == "1"
SUBS = (("2016-01-04", "2019-12-31", "2016-19"),
        ("2020-01-02", "2021-12-31", "2020-21"),
        ("2022-01-03", "2023-12-29", "2022-23"))

SYMS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ", "BIL")
COL = {"QQQ": 0, "TQQQ": 1, "BIL": 2}

EXIT_BAR = 31          # exit fills at the open of the session's 32nd bar (~10:01)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# panel and session plumbing
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def load(panel_end: str = DEV_END):
    return bt.panel(SYMS, DEV_START, panel_end, "1min", warmup_days=0)


def session_bounds(ts: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    _, starts, ends = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    return starts, ends


def block_log_returns(op: np.ndarray, starts: np.ndarray, ends: np.ndarray,
                      sym: str = "TQQQ") -> np.ndarray:
    """r[k] = log(exit open / entry open) for the block entered on session k."""
    c = COL[sym]
    ns = len(starts)
    r = np.full(ns, np.nan)
    for k in range(ns - 1):
        j = min(starts[k + 1] + EXIT_BAR, ends[k + 1])
        entry, exitp = op[ends[k], c], op[j, c]
        if entry > 0 and exitp > 0:
            r[k] = np.log(exitp / entry)
    return r


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# specification
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
@dataclass
class Params:
    use_close: bool = True        # apply the closing-pressure condition
    close_sign: int = -1          # -1: hold after a sold close; +1: momentum branch
    close_window: int = 30        # minutes in the closing block
    close_min_z: float = 0.5      # |c30| must be >= this multiple of typical
    close_ref: int = 20           # sessions in the |c30| median

    use_gate: bool = True         # apply the block-vol regime
    vol_look: int = 10            # sessions in the block-vol estimate
    ref_look: int = 60            # sessions in the median reference
    vol_mult: float = 1.5         # gate off when vol > vol_mult * median

    vol_target: float = 0.40      # annualised block-vol target; 0 disables sizing
    size_floor: float = 0.0

    idle: str = "cash"            # "cash" | "bil"

    def tag(self) -> str:
        return (f"close{int(self.use_close)}{self.close_sign}"
                f"w{self.close_window}z{self.close_min_z}"
                f"_gate{int(self.use_gate)}v{self.vol_look}"
                f"m{self.vol_mult}_t{self.vol_target}_{self.idle}")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# causal signals
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
_SIGNAL_CACHE: dict = {}


def clock_signals(ts, opens, closes, p: Params) -> dict:
    """Closing block return, its normaliser, block vol state.  All causal.

    Only four parameters enter the signals, and the variants, placebo and
    neighbourhood reuse them, so results are memoised per panel and those
    parameters.  The arrays are shared and must be treated as read-only.
    """
    key = (id(ts), id(opens), id(closes), p.close_window, p.close_ref,
           p.vol_look, p.ref_look)
    hit = _SIGNAL_CACHE.get(key)
    if hit is not None and hit[0] is ts and hit[1] is opens and hit[2] is closes:
        return dict(hit[3])
    sig = _clock_signals(ts, opens, closes, p)
    if len(_SIGNAL_CACHE) >= 32:
        _SIGNAL_CACHE.clear()
    _SIGNAL_CACHE[key] = (ts, opens, closes, sig)
    return dict(sig)


def _clock_signals(ts, opens, closes, p: Params) -> dict:
    starts, ends = session_bounds(ts)
    ns = len(starts)
    qc = closes[:, COL["QQQ"]]

    c30 = np.full(ns, np.nan)
    for k in range(ns):
        i1 = ends[k]
        j = max(starts[k], i1 - p.close_window)
        a, b = qc[j], qc[i1 - 1]      # close of bar (last-window) .. close of 15:58
        if a > 0 and b > 0:
            c30[k] = float(np.log(b / a))

    absref = np.full(ns, np.nan)
    for k in range(ns):
        lo = k - p.close_ref
        if lo < 0:
            continue
        w = np.abs(c30[lo:k])
        w = w[np.isfinite(w)]
        if w.size >= max(5, p.close_ref // 2):
            absref[k] = float(np.median(w))

    r = block_log_returns(opens, starts, ends, "TQQQ")
    vol = np.full(ns, np.nan)
    for k in range(ns):
        lo = k - p.vol_look
        if lo < 0:
            continue
        w = r[lo:k]
        if np.isfinite(w).all() and w.size > 2:
            vol[k] = float(np.std(w, ddof=1) * np.sqrt(252.0))
    ref = np.full(ns, np.nan)
    for k in range(ns):
        lo = k - p.ref_look
        if lo < 0:
            continue
        w = vol[lo:k]
        w = w[np.isfinite(w)]
        if w.size >= max(10, p.ref_look // 3):
            ref[k] = float(np.median(w))

    return {"c30": c30, "absref": absref, "r": r, "vol": vol, "ref": ref,
            "starts": starts, "ends": ends}


def block_sizes(sig: dict, p: Params) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict]:
    ns = len(sig["c30"])
    size = np.zeros(ns)
    fail = {"warmup": 0, "close_sign": 0, "close_small": 0, "vol_gate": 0}
    for k in range(ns):
        c30, absref = sig["c30"][k], sig["absref"][k]
        v, m = sig["vol"][k], sig["ref"][k]
        if p.use_close:
            if not (np.isfinite(c30) and np.isfinite(absref)) or absref <= 0:
                fail["warmup"] += 1
                continue
            if p.close_sign > 0 and not (c30 > 0):
                fail["close_sign"] += 1
                continue
            if p.close_sign < 0 and not (c30 < 0):
                fail["close_sign"] += 1
                continue
            if abs(c30) < p.close_min_z * absref:
                fail["close_small"] += 1
                continue
        if p.use_gate:
            if not (np.isfinite(v) and np.isfinite(m)) or v > p.vol_mult * m:
                fail["vol_gate"] += 1
                continue
        s = 1.0
        if p.vol_target > 0:
            if not np.isfinite(v):
                fail["warmup"] += 1
                continue
            s = min(1.0, p.vol_target / max(v, 1e-6))
        size[k] = max(p.size_floor, s)
    info = {"active_sessions": int((size > 0).sum()), "mean_size": float(size.mean()),
            "mean_size_when_active": float(size[size > 0].mean()) if (size > 0).any() else 0.0,
            "reject_reasons": fail}
    return size, info


def weights_from_size(ts, starts, ends, size, p: Params) -> np.ndarray:
    """Targets are set on a few bars per session and held until the next one."""
    ns, n = len(starts), len(ts)
    idle = (0.0, 0.0, 1.0) if p.idle == "bil" else (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    marks = {}                                     # bar -> row; later writes win
    for k in range(ns):
        if k > 0 and size[k - 1] > 0:
            j = min(starts[k] + EXIT_BAR, ends[k])
            marks[(j - 1) % n] = idle              # exit at ~10:01
        s = size[k]
        if s > 0:
            marks[(ends[k] - 1) % n] = (0.0, s, 0.0)   # entry at ~15:59
        else:
            marks[(ends[k] - 1) % n] = idle
    return _hold_rows(marks, n)


def _hold_rows(marks: dict, n: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Forward-fill the marked rows over n bars, zeros before the first one.

    Same result as filling an (n, 3) NaN array at the marks and running
    `pd.DataFrame(rows).ffill().fillna(0.0).to_numpy()`.
    """
    out = np.zeros((n, 3))
    if not marks:
        return out
    idx = np.fromiter(sorted(marks), dtype=np.int64, count=len(marks))
    vals = np.array([marks[i] for i in idx.tolist()], dtype=float)
    out[idx[0]:] = np.repeat(vals, np.diff(np.r_[idx, n]), axis=0)
    return out


def build_weights(ts, opens, closes, params: Params, sym: str = "TQQQ"
                  ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict]:
    """Target weights and diagnostics for the block strategy."""
    sig = clock_signals(ts, opens, closes, params)
    size, info = block_sizes(sig, params)
    w = weights_from_size(ts, sig["starts"], sig["ends"], size, params)
    info.update({"params": asdict(params), "sessions": int(len(sig["starts"])),
                 "exit_bar": EXIT_BAR, "entry": "open of the session's last bar"})
    return w, info


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# reference base (correlation only -- not part of the strategy)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def baseline_weights(ts, closes, sma: int = 165) -> np.ndarray:
    """Original shared base: TQQQ when QQQ close > SMA165, else BIL.

    Used only to measure F6 (daily-return correlation with the old base).  It is
    never combined with, called by, or mixed into the strategy weights.
    """
    sess = pd.DatetimeIndex(sorted(set(ts.date)))
    dcl = pd.Series(closes[:, 0], index=ts).groupby(ts.date).last()
    dcl.index = pd.to_datetime(dcl.index)
    sig = (dcl > dcl.rolling(sma).mean()).fillna(False).reindex(sess).to_numpy()
    starts, ends = session_bounds(ts)
    rows = np.full((len(ts), 3), np.nan)
    for k in range(len(ends)):
        rows[ends[k]] = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0] if sig[k] else [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).ffill().fillna(0.0).to_numpy()


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# evaluation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def slice_idx(ts, lo, hi):
    i = int(ts.searchsorted(pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York")))
    # Include the whole `hi` session.  A bare 00:00 timestamp drops the final
    # 09:30-15:59 bars and makes the curve end one session early.
    end = pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    j = int(ts.searchsorted(end, side="left"))
    return i, j


def run_window(w, ts, op, cl, lo, hi, slip):
    i, j = slice_idx(ts, lo, hi)
    res = bt.simulate(ts[i:j], op[i:j], cl[i:j], w[i:j], band=0.02, slippage_bps=slip)
    return res, bt.stats(res, BARS_1M)


def daily_returns(res):
    """Session-close returns (same as grouping the minute equity by date)."""
    dates, _, last = bt.day_bounds(res["ts"])
    eq = pd.Series(np.asarray(res["equity"])[last], index=pd.Index(dates[last]))
    return eq.pct_change().dropna()


def pack(s: dict) -> dict:
    return {"cagr": s["cagr"], "max_drawdown": s["max_drawdown"], "sharpe": s["sharpe"],
            "sortino": s["sortino"], "volatility": s["volatility"],
            "fills": s["fills"], "turnover": s["turnover"],
            "exposure": s["exposure"], "ending_equity": s["ending_equity"]}


def conditional_test(sig: dict, ts) -> dict:
    """F1: mean block return after a sold close vs a bought close (dev only)."""
    starts, ends = sig["starts"], sig["ends"]
    keep = (pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(sorted(set(ts.date)))) >= pd.Timestamp(DEV_START)) \
        & (pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(sorted(set(ts.date)))) <= pd.Timestamp(DEV_END))
    r, c30 = sig["r"], sig["c30"]
    m = np.isfinite(r) & np.isfinite(c30) & keep
    neg, pos = r[m & (c30 < 0)], r[m & (c30 >= 0)]
    if neg.size < 30 or pos.size < 30:
        return {"n_neg": int(neg.size), "n_pos": int(pos.size)}
    se = np.sqrt(neg.var(ddof=1) / neg.size + pos.var(ddof=1) / pos.size)
    diff = float(neg.mean() - pos.mean())
    return {"n_neg": int(neg.size), "n_pos": int(pos.size),
            "mean_bp_after_sold_close": float(neg.mean() * 1e4),
            "mean_bp_after_bought_close": float(pos.mean() * 1e4),
            "diff_bp": float(diff * 1e4),
            "t_stat": float(diff / se) if se > 0 else None,
            "hit_rate_neg": float((neg > 0).mean()),
            "hit_rate_pos": float((pos > 0).mean())}


def placebo(w, ts, op, cl, sig, p: Params, n_draws: int = 200, seed: int = 7) -> dict:
    """F5: shuffle which nights are active, keeping the same count and sizes."""
    size_real, _ = block_sizes(sig, p)
    active = np.flatnonzero(size_real > 0)
    if active.size == 0:
        return {"n_draws": 0}
    sizes = size_real[active]
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    cagrs = []
    res, st = run_window(w, ts, op, cl, DEV_START, DEV_END, 1.0)
    real = st["cagr"]
    # Same draws as run_window() one at a time, simulated in parallel batches.
    i, j = slice_idx(ts, DEV_START, DEV_END)
    batch = []
    for d in range(n_draws):
        perm = rng.permutation(size_real.size)
        s = np.zeros_like(size_real)
        s[perm[:active.size]] = sizes
        batch.append(weights_from_size(ts, sig["starts"], sig["ends"], s, p)[i:j])
        if len(batch) == 12 or d == n_draws - 1:
            for r in bt.simulate_many(ts[i:j], op[i:j], cl[i:j], batch,
                                      band=0.02, slippage_bps=1.0):
                cagrs.append(bt.stats(r, BARS_1M)["cagr"])
            batch = []
    cagrs = np.array(cagrs)
    return {"n_draws": n_draws, "real_cagr": float(real),
            "placebo_mean": float(cagrs.mean()), "placebo_p95": float(np.percentile(cagrs, 95)),
            "p_value": float((cagrs >= real).mean())}


def freeze_hash(params: Params) -> str:
    payload = (HERE / "strategy.py").read_bytes() + json.dumps(asdict(params),
                                                               sort_keys=True).encode()
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()[:16]


def decide(out_variants: dict, corr: dict, f1: dict, f5: dict,
           tqqq_dev_cagr: float) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    """Apply the pre-registered falsifiers.  Status is computed, never typed in."""
    v0 = out_variants["V0_unconditional"]["dev_1bp"]["cagr"]
    v1 = out_variants["V1_close_only"]["dev_1bp"]["cagr"]
    v3 = out_variants["V3_full"]["dev_1bp"]
    sub0 = out_variants["V0_unconditional"]["sub_periods_1bp"]
    sub1 = out_variants["V1_close_only"]["sub_periods_1bp"]

    f1_ok = bool(f1.get("diff_bp", 0.0) >= 5.0 and (f1.get("t_stat") or 0.0) >= 1.5)
    f2_ok = bool(v1 > v0)
    f3_ok = bool(v3["max_drawdown"] <= 0.45 and v3["sharpe"] >= 0.70)
    f4_ok = bool(sum(sub1[t]["cagr"] > sub0[t]["cagr"] for t in sub1) >= 2)
    f5_ok = bool(f5.get("p_value", 1.0) < 0.10)
    f6_ok = bool(corr["V3_full"] < 0.60)
    f7_ok = bool(out_variants["V3_full"]["dev_5bp"]["cagr"] > tqqq_dev_cagr)
    checks = {"F1_sign_and_size": f1_ok, "F2_conditioning_beats_unconditional": f2_ok,
              "F3_risk": f3_ok, "F4_subperiods": f4_ok, "F5_placebo": f5_ok,
              "F6_independence": f6_ok, "F7_cost_5bp": f7_ok,
              "V4_opposite_sign_cagr": out_variants["V4_momentum_sign"]["dev_1bp"]["cagr"],
              "V0_cagr": v0, "V1_cagr": v1}

    if not (f3_ok and f6_ok):
        status = "rejected"
    elif not f2_ok:
        status = "retired_overlay_only"
    elif f1_ok and f3_ok and f4_ok and f5_ok and f6_ok and f7_ok:
        status = "passed"
    elif f1_ok and f3_ok and f4_ok and f5_ok and f6_ok:
        status = "fragile"
    else:
        status = "rejected"
    return status, checks


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main() -> None:
    ts, op, cl = load(DEV_END)
    print(f"dev panel {len(ts):,} bars, {len(np.unique(ts.date))} sessions, "
          f"{ts[0].date()} .. {ts[-1].date()}")

    base = baseline_weights(ts, cl)
    bres, bs = run_window(base, ts, op, cl, DEV_START, DEV_END, 1.0)
    bdr = daily_returns(bres)
    print(f"165d baseline dev: CAGR {bs['cagr']*100:.2f}% DD {bs['max_drawdown']*100:.2f}%")

    variants = {
        "V0_unconditional": Params(use_close=False, use_gate=False, vol_target=0.0),
        "V1_close_only": Params(use_close=True, use_gate=False, vol_target=0.0),
        "V2_gate_only": Params(use_close=False, use_gate=True, vol_target=0.0),
        "V3_full": Params(),
        "V4_momentum_sign": Params(close_sign=+1),
        "V5_full_bil": Params(idle="bil"),
    }

    out_variants: dict[str, dict] = {}
    corr: dict[str, float] = {}
    for name, p in variants.items():
        w, info = build_weights(ts, op, cl, p)
        rec = {"params": asdict(p), "info": info}
        for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
            res, s = run_window(w, ts, op, cl, DEV_START, DEV_END, slip)
            rec[f"dev_{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
            if slip == 1.0:
                corr[name] = float(daily_returns(res).corr(bdr))
                sub = {}
                for lo, hi, tag in SUBS:
                    _, ss = run_window(w, ts, op, cl, lo, hi, 1.0)
                    sub[tag] = {"cagr": ss["cagr"], "max_drawdown": ss["max_drawdown"],
                                "sharpe": ss["sharpe"]}
                rec["sub_periods_1bp"] = sub
        rec["corr_vs_165d_baseline"] = corr[name]
        out_variants[name] = rec
        d = rec["dev_1bp"]
        print(f"{name:20s} 1bp CAGR {d['cagr']*100:6.2f}% DD {d['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}% "
              f"sh {d['sharpe']:4.2f} fills {d['fills']:5d} corr {corr[name]:.2f} "
              f"active {info['active_sessions']}")

    # F1 and F5 on the frozen full variant
    p3 = variants["V3_full"]
    sig = clock_signals(ts, op, cl, p3)
    w3 = build_weights(ts, op, cl, p3)[0]
    f1 = conditional_test(sig, ts)
    print("F1 conditional test:", f1)
    f5 = placebo(w3, ts, op, cl, sig, p3)
    print("F5 placebo:", f5)

    # parameter neighbourhood (+-1 step), V3 as the centre
    grid = {}
    for key, values in (("vol_look", (5, 10, 20)), ("ref_look", (40, 60, 90)),
                        ("vol_mult", (1.25, 1.5, 2.0)), ("close_window", (20, 30, 45)),
                        ("close_min_z", (0.0, 0.5, 1.0)), ("vol_target", (0.30, 0.40, 0.50))):
        row = {}
        for v in values:
            pp = Params(**{**asdict(p3), key: v})
            w, _ = build_weights(ts, op, cl, pp)
            _, s = run_window(w, ts, op, cl, DEV_START, DEV_END, 1.0)
            row[str(v)] = {"cagr": s["cagr"], "max_drawdown": s["max_drawdown"],
                           "sharpe": s["sharpe"]}
        grid[key] = row
    print("neighbourhood:", {k: {kk: round(vv["cagr"] * 100, 1) for kk, vv in v.items()}
                             for k, v in grid.items()})

    # ---- freeze, then dev only unless the lead explicitly runs the full sample ---- #
    frozen = freeze_hash(p3)
    windows = {"dev": {}, "holdout": {}, "10y": {}, "5y": {}}
    tqqq = {}
    qqq = {}
    if DEV_ONLY:
        ts2, op2, cl2 = load(DEV_END)
        w_warm = build_weights(ts2, op2, cl2, p3)[0]
        for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
            _, s = run_window(w_warm, ts2, op2, cl2, DEV_START, DEV_END, slip)
            windows["dev"][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
        i, j = slice_idx(ts2, DEV_START, DEV_END)
        tqqq["dev"] = bt.benchmark(cl2[i:j, 1], ts2[i:j], BARS_1M)
        tqqq["dev"]["symbol"] = "TQQQ"
        qqq["dev"] = bt.benchmark(cl2[i:j, 0], ts2[i:j], BARS_1M)
    else:
        ts2, op2, cl2 = load(FULL_END)
        w_warm = build_weights(ts2, op2, cl2, p3)[0]
        for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
            _, s = run_window(w_warm, ts2, op2, cl2, DEV_START, DEV_END, slip)
            windows["dev"][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
        for tag, lo, hi in (("10y", T10, FULL_END), ("5y", T5, FULL_END)):
            for slip in (1.0, 5.0):
                _, s = run_window(w_warm, ts2, op2, cl2, lo, hi, slip)
                windows[tag][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
        for tag, lo, hi in (("dev", DEV_START, DEV_END), ("10y", T10, FULL_END), ("5y", T5, FULL_END)):
            i, j = slice_idx(ts2, lo, hi)
            tqqq[tag] = bt.benchmark(cl2[i:j, 1], ts2[i:j], BARS_1M)
            tqqq[tag]["symbol"] = "TQQQ"
        i, j = slice_idx(ts2, DEV_START, DEV_END)
        qqq["dev"] = bt.benchmark(cl2[i:j, 0], ts2[i:j], BARS_1M)

    status, checks = decide(out_variants, corr, f1, f5, tqqq["dev"]["cagr"])

    result = {
        "agent": "time-of-day",
        "original": "research/agents/time-of-day",
        "status": status,
        "idea": "The overnight+first-30m block pays because it settles the previous "
                "session's closing pressure, so it should be held selectively after "
                "a sold close rather than every night.",
        "hypothesis": "Block return is decreasing in the last-30-minute QQQ return; "
                      "conditioning plus a self-referential vol gate beats holding "
                      "every night.",
        "universe": ["TQQQ", "BIL (idle variant only)", "cash"],
        "frozen_commit": frozen,
        "variants_tried": len(variants),
        "corr_vs_165d_baseline": corr["V3_full"],
        "max_corr_vs_other_rebuilds": None,
        "windows": windows,
        "marks": "1m",
        "benchmarks": {"tqqq": tqqq, "qqq": qqq, "spy": None,
                       "original": {"note": "original result.json is on 2017-2026 / "
                                            "2021-2026 windows, 10y 49.23%/42.66%, "
                                            "5y 28.89%/34.54% at 1bp"}},
        "diagnostics": {"falsifiers": checks, "f1_conditional": f1, "f5_placebo": f5,
                        "neighbourhood": grid, "baseline_dev": pack(bs)},
    }
    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=float))
    print("wrote result.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
